Title: LNER Calf Barrow, King's Cross For Livestock Only
Brief description: Calf barrow, London & North Eastern Railway, 2 axles / 4 wheels / solid tyres, 2 end doors. Marked "E124 King's Cross For Livestock Only".

From the mid-nineteenth century to the 1970s, the railways provided an essential link for transporting livestock between farm, port and market. Many stations had cattle docks for loading livestock into vans. Barrows such as this provided the means to transport calves between van and pen.
